verdict_semantics.NONFINITE: NaN/Inf reaches the output -- degeneracy visible -- robust
verdict_semantics.SILENT_WRONG: finite, unwarned, and wrong beyond the module's own tolerance

origin_singularity.description: degeneracies at or across the r=0 origin singularity, field level

cases.degeneracy: r_min = 0.0 -> log(0) = -inf at the origin node
r_min = -1.0 -> log of a negative radius
r_min == r_max -> drho = 0, collapsed radial extent
cases.exception: ValueError: PolarGrid requires r_min < r_max (ascending radial interval), got r_min=1.0, r_max=1.0. A reversed interval silently swaps which radial boundary condition applies at which end; a collapsed one gives drho = 0.
IndexError: index 1 is out of bounds for axis 0 with size 1

cases.degeneracy: a single NaN in the vorticity field
a single +Inf in the vorticity field
